artifact_tree.run_manifest.json: selected corpus, local source paths, sha256, size, article keys, class labels, no-network setting
artifact_tree.backend-preflight.json: GROBID/OpenDataLoader versions, health, image/cache inventory, network-disabled behavior
artifact_tree.per-paper/<article_key>/grobid.tei.xml: raw TEI sidecar candidate, not graph-ready
artifact_tree.per-paper/<article_key>/opendataloader/o: layout/OCR/table sidecar candidate, fixed upstream schema
artifact_tree.per-paper/<article_key>/typed-candidates: Adaptix/daily-archive typed candidate summaries with candidate_only flags
artifact_tree.per-paper/<article_key>/quality-review.j: reviewed metric results and typed failures per quality dimension
artifact_tree.review-packets/<article_key>/: candidate graph-readiness review inputs, not import eligibility
artifact_tree.events.jsonl: bounded diagnostics with no secrets and no raw article bodies
artifact_tree.summary.json: aggregate pass/fail, blocker taxonomy, and false safety flags

json_shape_expectations.all_json: must include schema_version or schema/status equivalent, generated timestamp when produced, source references where applicable, and safety_flags on aggregate verdict artifacts
json_shape_expectations.candidate_outputs: must include candidate_only=true and never import_eligible=true
json_shape_expectations.events: one JSON object per line with event, phase/task, article_key when applicable, diagnostic code for failures, and no raw article body text

logging_rules: No secrets in artifacts or logs
No raw article bodies in diagnostics or aggregate summaries
Use excerpts only when bounded/redacted and justified
Record hashes/paths/IDs instead of full content

diagnostic_taxonomy.meaning: selected row lacks safe local PDF/source path
source hash missing, mismatched, or stale
required cache absent while no-network mode is enforced
GROBID returned invalid or unusable TEI
OCR control did not meet adequacy threshold
fixed parser output could not be mapped to typed candidates
candidate anchor lacks stable source hash/path/span/coordinate linkage
substantive body/source quality inadequate despite parser output
review packet missing completed review/output contract
